LESSON: VIRTUES GENEROSITY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Virtues Generosity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues Generosity
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should a Muslim practise generosity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise generosity as a virtue for character formation
2. appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation

Teach
• Today’s focus: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “practise generosity as a virtue for character formation” using a school example.
• Model B for “practise generosity as a virtue for character formation” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "practise generosity as a virtue for character formation" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation
• Model 2: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation
2. Practise: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues Generosity.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim practise generosity?
2. When should a Muslim practise generosity?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• practise generosity as a virtue for character formation
• appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
